issues.reason: "Full" is a member-level descriptive modifier (each class is full, and the "of 48 each" gloss confirms it), and the plural rules state that such a modifier "distributes over the members exactly like a copular predicate", a bare (Member <group> <prop>) being reserved for a property of the collection itself.

Carrying no truth value is inherent to every sealed conjunct, not a defect of this one, and the missing GroupOf would have to invent what the 48 are (the text never says) — this is the binominal-distributive gap the reviewer itself registers, and the improvisation emits nothing false: each class does number 48.

Booking reserves the classes without creating, destroying or altering them — and a booked class is not an occurrence whose happening or timing is changed, unlike cancel/postpone — so the change test (and the default-to-Theme fallback) gives Theme.

"its classes" is a possessed plural, hence definite, and "Definite referents inside a seal project" applies "in every sealing construct alike", with the group case explicitly naming GroupOf typing as what sits outside.

gaps_confirmed: Binominal distributive numeral — "classes of 48 each", a per-member count riding on a plural.
Scope of a medial parenthetical attribution — "<clause>, he said, and <clause>" gives no rule for whether the following coordinate clause falls inside the report.
A boundary phrase as an interval endpoint — "through the end of next month"; End is specified for structured terms and deictic constants, not for "the end of X".
new_gaps: Distribution inside a seal has no stated form: the only way to attach a member-level property to a sealed plural is a rule term with a free variable nested in an asserted atom, which no section licenses (nor forbids).
"through X" as an inclusive endpoint is not distinguished from "until X" — both land on End with no marker of inclusivity.
repair_summary: (Member sk_classes_1 full) is removed and "full" folded into the existing per-member rule, which becomes (Implication (PartOf $x sk_classes_1) (And (Member $x full) (Cardinality $x 48))) — merged rather than added as a second rule so the two would not share one variable inside a single term. (Patient sk_book_1 sk_classes_1) becomes (Theme sk_book_1 sk_classes_1). (GroupOf sk_agency_classes_1 class) moves out of the sealed term to top level as the definite's projected typing atom.
notes: The nested Implication is kept as the parse's own device for a construction the instruction set does not cover, and the "full" repair reuses it rather than introducing a second, inconsistent mechanism. Sealing both coordinated clauses under "he said" is left standing as the defensible reading of the medial attribution.
